newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel economic performance index down in August.
newsitem.headline: Israel economic performance index down in August.

text.p: Israel's economic performance or "S" index fell 0.2 percent in August, the Bank of Israel said.

The "S" index is made up of four components: retail sales, which rose 0.5 percent in August; imports, which fell 9.5 percent in August; industrial production, which fell 0.8 percent in July; and the number of workers, which has not been published since January.
Note: figures for industrial production lag by a month.
In the first eight months of the year the index rose 3.5 percent, against a 7.3 percent rise in the same period last year.
The Bank of Israel said that since April the index shows that economic activity has stabilised.
